name: Northern Ghana 1-in-100 year flood
description: A representative 1-in-100 year return period (1% annual probability) flood on the Black Volta and White Volta, Ghana. River and surface water flood combined. Provided by JBA Risk Management.

vulnerability.source: JRC global flood depth-damage functions (Huizinga, De Moel and Szewczyk, 2017)
vulnerability.description: Damage by flood depth from the JRC global flood depth-damage functions for Africa, by occupancy class: residential, commercial, industrial, transport, infrastructure or agriculture (from the OED occupancy code). These are not JBA's own vulnerability functions; JBA provided the flood footprints.
